basic_details.job_title: DMRC Chief Architect Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Ltd (DMRC) has invited applications for one Chief Architect post (Post Code 01/CA) on Post Retirement Contractual Engagement (PRCE) basis, with consolidated remuneration of Rs.182500/- per month for the Delhi office. The age limit is minimum 55 years and maximum 62 years as on 01 November 2026. The engagement is initially for one year. Applications must be sent by Speed Post or by email to [email protected], and must be received by 26 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit is minimum 55 years and maximum 62 years as on 01/11/2026. The notice prints no age relaxation.

selection_process: List of shortlisted candidates on the DMRC websiteFirst week of December 2026 (tentatively)
Screening, offline/online modeSecond week of December 2026 (tentatively)
Screening for candidates applying on PRCE basis comprises a Personal Interview and a Medical fitness examination. The Medical Examination is in the Executive/Technical category
and its details are available on the DMRC website. The selection process judges different facets of knowledge
aptitude and physical fitness. Candidates must qualify the screening and the medical examination
as applicable. The notice says the Corporation's decision is final on this.
how_to_apply: Fill in the application format at Annexure-I of the notice, in capital letters, and affix a recent passport size self-attested photograph.
Enclose all relevant documents in support of qualification, experience, pay and pay scale.

If you are presently employed in a Govt. Organisation/Railways/Metro Organization/CPWD/PSU, send the application through proper channel, forwarded by the Cadre Controlling Authority of the parent organisation, with Vigilance and D&AR clearance in the Annexure-II pro-forma. Those not working must also submit the Annexure-II clearance.

By Speed Post: put the application in an envelope with the name of the post written prominently on the cover and send it to: Additional General Manager/HR/P, Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Ltd., Metro Bhawan, Fire Brigade Lane, Barakhamba Road, New Delhi.
By email: send the scanned application form and scanned copies of all other documents to [email protected], with the advt. No. in the subject of the email.
Make sure the application is received by 26.11.2026. Incomplete applications and those received after the due date are summarily rejected. DMRC is not responsible for loss or delay in post.
Last promotion order in support of substantive grade
NOC from present Employer, if presently working in Govt. Organisations/Railways/Metro Organizations/CPWD/PSUs
D&AR and Vigilance clearance in the pro-forma at Annexure-II
important_instructions: No separate communication by post is sent to candidates individually. Instructions and the screening schedule are displayed on the DMRC website. Candidates must appear for the screening with the original copies of testimonials. Candidates who fail the prescribed medical test will not be given any alternative employment. Under no circumstances are advance copies entertained. Only applications forwarded through proper channel by the Cadre Controlling Authority are entertained. The vacancy is provisional and subject to increase or decrease. The application declares that the candidature will be cancelled if any information is found incorrect or false at any time.

content_sections.heading: About DMRC
content_sections.text: The notice describes DMRC as a Joint Venture company with equal equity participation from the Govt. of India and the Govt. of the National Capital Territory of Delhi. It has been entrusted with implementing the rail-based Mass Rapid Transit System for Delhi. The notice says DMRC has about 14,000 employees, works across Delhi/NCR and other cities in India and abroad, and also provides consultancy services to cities in India and abroad.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from persons of Indian nationality who are working in or retired from Govt. Organisations/Railways/Metro Organizations/CPWD/PSUs and have relevant work experience in the Architecture department. The notice lists these conditions, all reckoned as on 01/11/2026: Varied experience of working in the Architecture department in Govt. Organisations/Railways/Metro Organizations/CPWD/PSUs. Conversant with functioning in a computerized environment. Free from D&AR and Vigilance angle. Working in or retired from the CDA pay scale at Level 14 (144200–218200) as per 7th CPC, or higher grade; or working in or retired from the IDA pay scale of Rs. 120000 – 280000/-, or higher grade, including services on deputation. A total of 18 (Eighteen) years' service at the Gazetted / Executive level in these organisations. Candidates must be working in or retired from the functional grade on a regular basis; MACP benefits and the like are not considered. Candidates now in regular service are also eligible, provided they opt for retirement through VRS or otherwise before joining DMRC. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility. Hands on knowledge of various computer applications relating to the job. The age limit is minimum 55 years and maximum 62 years as on 01/11/2026. The notice prints no age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement on PRCE basis is initially for one year. The term on contract may be extended further, subject to the requirement of the Corporation and satisfactory performance. Emoluments are in terms of the extant rules of DMRC. Selected candidates are liable to be posted or transferred to any office or project site under the control of the Corporation, in India or abroad.

rows.retired_from_ida_pay_scale: IDA pay scale of Rs. 120000-280000/-, or higher

content_sections.heading: DMRC Chief Architect Job Description
content_sections.text: The incumbent shall be responsible for all Architectural works pertaining to Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Ltd.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMRC Chief Architect
content_sections.text: Fill in the application format at Annexure-I of the notice, in capital letters, and affix a recent passport size self-attested photograph. Enclose all relevant documents in support of qualification, experience, pay and pay scale. If you are presently employed in a Govt. Organisation/Railways/Metro Organization/CPWD/PSU, send the application through proper channel, forwarded by the Cadre Controlling Authority of the parent organisation, with Vigilance and D&AR clearance in the Annexure-II pro-forma. Those not working must also submit the Annexure-II clearance. By Speed Post: put the application in an envelope with the name of the post written prominently on the cover and send it to: Additional General Manager/HR/P, Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Ltd., Metro Bhawan, Fire Brigade Lane, Barakhamba Road, New Delhi. By email: send the scanned application form and scanned copies of all other documents to [email protected] , with the advt. No. in the subject of the email. Make sure the application is received by 26.11.2026. Incomplete applications and those received after the due date are summarily rejected. DMRC is not responsible for loss or delay in post. Educational Certificates (Matriculation/Graduation/Post Graduation & Others) Work Experience Certificate/Service certificate Last promotion order in support of substantive grade Copy of PPO NOC from present Employer, if presently working in Govt. Organisations/Railways/Metro Organizations/CPWD/PSUs D&AR and Vigilance clearance in the pro-forma at Annexure-II

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening for candidates applying on PRCE basis comprises a Personal Interview and a Medical fitness examination. The Medical Examination is in the Executive/Technical category, and its details are available on the DMRC website. The selection process judges different facets of knowledge, skills, comprehension, aptitude and physical fitness. Candidates must qualify the screening and the medical examination, as applicable. The notice says the Corporation's decision is final on this.

faq.question: Q1. How many Chief Architect posts has DMRC announced?
faq.answer: DMRC has announced one Chief Architect post (Post Code 01/CA). The notice says the vacancy is provisional and subject to increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DMRC Chief Architect?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the application is 26.11.2026, by Speed Post or email. Applications received after the due date are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for DMRC Chief Architect?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 55 years and maximum 62 years as on 01/11/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of DMRC Chief Architect?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs.182500/- per month for the Delhi office, along with other benefits as per company policy. It is subject to the candidate's last substantive grade.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is required for DMRC Chief Architect?
faq.answer: Candidates need varied experience in the Architecture department in Govt. Organisations/Railways/Metro Organizations/CPWD/PSUs. They also need a total of 18 years' service at the Gazetted/Executive level, with CDA Level 14 or higher or IDA Rs. 120000–280000 or higher.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for DMRC Chief Architect?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure-I application form with documents by Speed Post to Additional General Manager/HR/P at Metro Bhawan, Fire Brigade Lane, Barakhamba Road, New Delhi. Alternatively, email scanned copies to [email protected] with the advt. No. in the subject.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for DMRC Chief Architect?
faq.answer: Screening comprises a Personal Interview and a Medical fitness examination. Shortlisted candidates are listed on the DMRC website, tentatively in the first week of December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DMRC Chief Architect post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a Post Retirement Contractual Engagement. The term is initially one year and may be extended subject to the Corporation's requirement and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Can serving government employees apply for DMRC Chief Architect?
faq.answer: Yes, but they must opt for retirement through VRS or otherwise before joining DMRC. They must also apply through proper channel with Vigilance and D&AR clearance (Annexure-II).

faq.question: Q10. Where will the Chief Architect posting be?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are liable to be posted or transferred to any office or project site under the control of the Corporation, in India or abroad.
